Reagent purity/supplier, heating ramp, autoclave pressure, agitation during reaction, cooling rate, centrifugation settings, wash volumes/repetitions and powder drying are unreported.
Time, feed-ratio and alcohol comparisons preserve their own stated conditions; separate absolute charges and individual batch identities are not automatically inherited.

Reported ± values have no stated statistical estimator or counting population.
conflicts: Main p. 2 describes a broad (001) XRD reflection whereas Figure S1 labels the broad peak (004); indexing discrepancy retained.
Sol-gel heading, main comparison and Figure S8 specify Ti foil, but the SI operational paragraph twice specifies glass. The relationship between these specimens remains unresolved.
Figure S3 calls its ordinate Weight Loss (%) while the traces begin near 100 and decrease. The caption-reported loss percentages are retained without reinterpreting or digitizing the curves.
Main Figure 1 caption calls panel c small angle electron diffraction; body calls it selected-area electron diffraction.
Main describes low visible-light absorption for the sol-gel comparison, while Figure S8 reports diffuse reflectance; neither signal is converted.
